name: com.handshakr/handshakr
title: Handshakr
description: Read-only search of Handshakr's register of B2B suppliers, a record built for AI buying agents.

tools.name: search_sellers
tools.description: Search the Handshakr suppliers an AI agent may read, by keyword and optional category. Returns name, slug, category, location, description and `contactable`: true only for suppliers who have switched agent access on, the only ones an agent may approach. Claimed suppliers who have not consented are not returned. `description` and `category` are the company's own words or null; text Handshakr wrote from public sources is in `handshakr_summary` / `handshakr_category`, labelled, and is not a fact about the company. `trust_score` is null: no score is computed.

query.description: Search term matched against seller name and description.

limit.description: Maximum number of suppliers to return (1 to 50, default 10).

tools.name: get_seller
tools.description: Fetch one Handshakr supplier an AI agent may read, by slug. `contactable` says whether the supplier has switched agent access on and may be approached. `description` and `category` are the company's own words or null; text Handshakr wrote from public sources is in `handshakr_summary` / `handshakr_category`, labelled, and is not a fact about the company. `trust_score` is null: no score is computed. `trading_name_of`, when not null, names the registered company this listing is a trading name of (legal name, company number, the passport holding its Companies House record): listings that share a company number there are one company, not several. `verifiable_record` is the latest signed, append-only version of the public passport: its version, sha256, log position, and where to fetch the W3C Verifiable Credential and its status.

tools.name: get_public_pulse
tools.description: Recent public activity in the Handshakr register: suppliers newly published and source pulse events. Only suppliers an AI agent may read are named.

limit.description: How many recent events to return (1 to 100, default 25).

tools.name: get_trending_categories
tools.description: Top trending supplier categories among the suppliers an AI agent may read, this week vs last week, with delta percentage. Returns available:false with a reason when too few recently published profiles are categorised to compute a trend, an empty result is never a silent zero.

limit.description: How many categories to return (1 to 30, default 8).
